# Partial linear model

Estimate $Y - f_Y(X)\sim D - f_D(X)$, which can be rewriten as

$$Y\simeq\beta_D D  + \underbrace{f_Y(X) - \beta_D f_D(X)}_{=f(X)}$$


## 例: Sizeのバランス

```{r, dev='ragg_png'}
set.seed(111)

library(tidyverse)

Data = read_csv("Public/Example.csv") |> 
  mutate(
    Price = Price |> log()
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    EmebedSize = mean(Size),
    EmbedTenure = mean(Tenure),
    EmbedDistance = mean(Size),
    .by = District
  )

Group = sample(
  1:2,
  nrow(Data),
  replace = TRUE
)

Data$HatY_OLS = lm(
  Price ~ poly(Size,4), 
  Data,
  subset = Group == 1
  ) |> 
  predict(Data) |> 
  as.numeric()


Data$HatD_OLS = lm(
  D ~ poly(Size,4), 
  Data,
  subset = Group == 1
  ) |> 
  predict(Data) |> 
  as.numeric()

Data$HatY_RF = ranger::ranger(
  Price ~ Size,
  Data[Group == 1,]
  ) |> 
  predict(Data) |> 
  magrittr::extract2("predictions") |> 
  as.numeric()

Data$HatD_RF = ranger::ranger(
  D ~ Size,
  Data[Group == 1,]
  ) |>
  predict(Data) |> 
  magrittr::extract2("predictions") |> 
  as.numeric()


Data$HatY = lm(Price ~ HatY_RF + HatY_OLS,
   Data,
   subset = Group == 2) |> 
  predict(Data)|> 
  as.numeric()

Data$HatD = lm(D ~ HatD_OLS + HatD_RF ,
   Data,
   subset = Group == 2) |> 
  predict(Data)|> 
  as.numeric()

Data$HatY_Within_OLS = lm(Price ~ Size,
   Data,
   subset = Group == 1) |> 
  predict(Data)|> 
  as.numeric()

Data$HatD_Within_OLS = lm(D ~ Size,
   Data,
   subset = Group == 1) |> 
  predict(Data)|> 
  as.numeric()


PLR = lm(
  TempY ~ 0 + TempD, 
  Data |> 
    mutate(
      TempY = Price - HatY, 
      TempD = D - HatD),
  subset = Group == 2
   )

lm(Price ~ 0 + D + HatY_Within_OLS + HatD_Within_OLS,
   Data,
   subset = Group == 2)

lm(Price ~ 0 + D + HatY_OLS + HatD_OLS,
   Data,
   subset = Group == 2)

Result = Data |> 
  filter(Group == 2)

Result$OLSWeight = lmw::lmw(
  ~ 0 + D + HatY_Within_OLS + HatD_Within_OLS, 
  Data[Group == 2,]) |> 
  magrittr::extract2("weights")


Result$Weight = lmw::lmw(
  ~ 0 + D + HatD + HatY,
  Data[Group == 2,]) |> 
  magrittr::extract2("weights")

Fig1 = cobalt::bal.tab(
  D ~ poly(Size,4),
  data = Result,
  weights = "Weight"
) |> 
  cobalt::love.plot() +
  xlab("PLR")

Fig2 = cobalt::bal.tab(
  D ~ poly(Size,4),
  data = Result,
  weights = "OLSWeight"
) |> 
  cobalt::love.plot() +
  xlab("OLS")

cowplot::plot_grid(
  Fig1 + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  Fig2+ theme(legend.position = "none"),
  ncol = 1
  )
```
